desc:
You've been thrown into a survival challenge.
How do you handle
this overwhelming situation?
option: Dive in and figure it out as you go.
Make a plan first, then move systematically.

desc:
A stranger approaches and
tries to talk to you.
What do you do?
option: Engage actively and try to make an ally.
Stay cautious and keep your distance.

desc:
The first mission begins.
Fail and you're eliminated.
How do you react?
option: Step forward and assess the situation yourself.
Observe others and follow their lead.

desc:
You have some downtime
before the next challenge.
How do you spend it?
option: Mingle with other participants.
Find a quiet corner to think alone.

desc:
A conflict breaks out
among participants.
What do you do?
option: Step in and try to mediate.
Stay back and observe.

desc:
You must decide whether to
continue despite the danger.
What guides your decision?
option: The concrete risks and your immediate survival odds.
Your goals and what might be possible if you push through.

desc:
You've learned critical information
about the next challenge.
What do you do?
option: Keep it to yourself to gain a competitive edge.
Share it with teammates you trust.

desc:
You sense danger might be coming...
How do you handle
the anxiety?
option: Wait and see — it might not happen.
Prepare contingency plans with your team.

desc:
The next mission is a team event.
You need a team,
but what do you do...
option: Take initiative and actively recruit teammates.
Wait for someone to approach you first.

desc:
You must choose a partner.
Skilled but unpredictable vs
reliable but unproven.
option: Go with the skilled one — potential matters more.
Go with the reliable one — stability comes first.

desc:
In a head-to-head elimination,
your opponent is someone you've bonded with.
How do you play?
option: Set emotions aside and compete to win.
You can't bring yourself to go all out against them.

desc:
At a crucial moment,
the person in front hesitates.
Time is almost up...
option: Calmly move ahead on your own.
Give them a little more time.

desc:
The night before the final challenge.
Tomorrow, everything ends.
What are you doing?
option: Resting up to be at your best tomorrow.
Analyzing what the final challenge might be.

desc:
After everything is over,
how do you plan
your next steps?
option: Handle one concrete task at a time.
Think big picture and map out the future.
